note: Read 2026-11-01 at the owner's word ("Build those first 3 starting with ledger first"; of the 21 countries read first: "It should cover across every country"; "Retry the blocked tax facts once all countries land"): the tax on a screen worker's pay in Zimbabwe: a resident's income tax, social contributions, what is withheld at source, a non-resident artiste's withholding, an author's treatment, VAT and the tax year. Research and retry subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-tax.md, BRIEF-tax-retry.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page.

figures.finding: Employment income earned in US dollars is taxed on the latest published ZIMRA table (January-December 2025): nothing to USD 1,200 a year, then 20%, 25% (from 3,601), 30% (from 12,001), 35% (from 24,001) and 40% above 36,000, by multiply-and-deduct, plus an Aids Levy of 3% of the tax; income from trade and investments is taxed at 25%. No 2026 table is posted on ZIMRA's tax-tables page.

value.table2026: not published on the tax-tables page at 2026-11-01

figures.applies: USD earnings of Zimbabwean employees; tax = income x rate - deduct; the 2025 table is the latest ZIMRA has posted.

sources.said: PAY AS YOU EARN ( PAYE) FOREIGN CURRENCY TAX TABLES FOR JANUARY TO DECEMBER 2025
from 0 to 1,200.00 multiply by 0% Deduct - $32 000 per year from 1,201 to 3,600.00 multiply by 20% Deduct 240
from 36,001 and above multiply by 40% Deduct 4,020
Aids Levy is 3% of the Individuals' Tax payable
Income of individual from trade and investments 14(2b) 25%

figures.finding: The employer deducts PAYE from pay before paying it and remits it to ZIMRA by the 10th of the following month, in the currency the income was earned in.

sources.said: Any employer who deducts PAYE from the employee’s remuneration is expected to remit the amount to ZIMRA on or before the 10 th of the following month.

figures.finding: A trader must register for VAT once taxable supplies exceed or are expected to exceed USD 25,000 (or ZiG equivalent) in 12 months.

sources.said: With effect from 1 January 2024 a trader is liable to register for VAT if the value of taxable supplies exceeds or is expected to exceed US$25,000.00 or ZiG equivalent within a period of 12 months.

figures.finding: VAT is charged at the standard rate of 15.5% on goods and services unless they are exempt, zero-rated or at a special rate.
figures.applies: ZIMRA's VAT page as read on 2026-11-01 (VAT Act Chapter 23:12).

sources.said: Rates of VAT i Standard rate of 15.5% Generally, all goods and services are standard rated unless specifically exempted, zero-rated or subject to VAT at a special rate
